samples.name: Shale Sentry
samples.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE standalone portrait 4:5 full-bleed card illustration for the original Scoundrel dungeon game, Ash & Briar edition.
Input image: the supplied Ash & Briar four-card concept board is a STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY. Generate one new illustration, not a board or a crop. Follow the broad brush shapes and striking simple silhouette of its individual panels. Original designs with the expressive painted fantasy character appeal of Legends of Runeterra, pared back to essential shapes.
Art direction: large confident opaque gouache brush planes, limited color families, soft lost edges, bold thumbnail-readable shape. Make the art as SIMPLE as the reference board or simpler. ONE main subject, at most ONE prop, ONE large background silhouette on a calm softly painted ground. No tiny repeated textures. Keep sharpest edges at the face or the important object edge. Interesting pose and directional lighting, 70% suit color family / 20% neutral / 10% highlight. Clear light-dark separation. Broad quiet empty areas.
Composition: portrait 4:5, subject centered within central 75% for later card cropping, illustration painted to all four edges. No frame, numbers, suit glyphs, text, labels, logos or watermark; the game will add these separately. No multiview, no montage, no separate swatches.
Avoid: photorealism, 3D-rendered polish, microdetail, etched ornament, complex armor, tiny gems, individual bark grooves, scattered leaves, particles, dust motes, busy scenery, line hatch, noisy canvas grain, strong black vignette. Do not copy any existing franchise character.

Subject and scene: Shale Sentry. One compact broad-shouldered STONEKIN guard with a square stone jaw, small blunt horns, heavy rectangular hands and slate-grey body built from a few large smooth rock planes. A simple dark brown shoulder wrap; one short plain stone club rests across the shoulder. Waist-up THREE-QUARTER SIDE VIEW, chin raised, alert stern expression, body angled left and eyes looking right. Quiet cool misty pale-grey ground with ONE broad charcoal arch shape. Palette charcoal #282D36, slate #687483, pale stone #C6CCD0; no glowing cracks. Left-side daylight, uncluttered strong square silhouette.
